name: breath-cue
title: Breath Cue
description: Track your work status in the menu bar and take guided breathing breaks on demand or after calls, long focus, and frequent app switching.
author: ilzira_badretdinova

commands.name: work-status
commands.title: Work Status
commands.subtitle: Breath Cue
commands.description: Shows what you are doing right now and brings up a breathing overlay at natural breaks.

commands.name: breathe-now
commands.title: Breathe Now
commands.subtitle: Breath Cue
commands.description: Start a one-minute breathing overlay right away.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
